name: Monachil (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Monachil (a mountain on blue above a pomegranate on white).
history: Monachil adopted its arms and flag officially on 7 May 2009; the flag is a cloth of 3:2 divided horizontally into three stripes of equal width, blue above, white in the centre and green below.

features.role: Monachil arms — mountain above a pomegranate
